Priyanka Iyer
Senior Financial Analyst | Hyderabad, Telangana
priyanka.iyer184@example.com | +91 9603385572

Analytical finance professional with strong experience across corporate finance, FP&A and financial systems. Skilled at building models, driving variance analysis and translating data into management-ready reports and dashboards. Comfortable working with cross-functional teams to implement SAP FICO integrations and visual analytics.

Experience
Bluefin Logistics — Apr 2026 - Present
Senior Financial Analyst
- Implemented SAP FICO month-end routines and reconciliations, reducing close cycle by 30% and improving balance accuracy for 6 legal entities.
- Built forward-looking Financial Modelling templates for freight and warehousing revenue streams; enabled scenario analysis that informed pricing changes and increased margin by 2.5 percentage points.
- Developed Power BI operational dashboards consolidating 12 source feeds; dashboards cut ad-hoc reporting requests by 45% and provided daily KPI visibility to operations and finance.
- Performed monthly Variance Analysis against budget and rolling forecast; produced commentary pack that identified cost drivers and supported a 5% YOY cost containment program.

Kite Learning — Dec 2020 - Mar 2026
Financial Analyst
- Led IFRS-compliant month-end accounting for revenue recognition and deferred revenue schedules across subscription products, reducing audit adjustments by 60%.
- Managed FP&A process for quarterly forecasting and annual budgeting; coordinated assumptions with sales and product teams, improving forecast accuracy from ±12% to ±6%.
- Created advanced Microsoft Excel models with pivot tables, index-match and macros to automate consolidation for 8 business units, saving ~80 hours per quarter.
- Conducted Variance Analysis and presented P&L drivers to senior management, enabling strategic reallocation of marketing spend and a 10% increase in CAC efficiency.

NimbusSoft — Oct 2017 - Nov 2020
Financial Analyst
- Designed Power BI reports for product profitability and utilization, enabling product managers to reprioritize features and increase revenue per user by 8%.
- Owned FP&A deliverables including monthly rolling forecasts and sensitivity models for subscription churn scenarios.
- Supported SAP FICO configuration for cost center reporting and GL mapping during a system migration; validated mapping and reduced mapping errors by 70%.
- Constructed Financial Modelling for new product launches with scenario outputs used by leadership to approve two product investments with projected IRR > 25%.

Capgemini — Oct 2016 - Sep 2017
UI/UX Designer
- Delivered UI/UX Design for client-facing portals using Figma; produced interactive prototypes and usability test plans that reduced user onboarding time by 20%.
- Collaborated with product and engineering teams to iterate designs and document patterns in Confluence for cross-team reuse.
- Conducted user research and created wireframes and high-fidelity screens to improve conversion flows for enterprise applications.

Projects
- Self-service Reporting Portal: Built a Power BI driven portal combining finance and operations data to enable month-end packet self-service; adoption reached 85% of business stakeholders within first quarter.
- Expense Automation Macro Suite: Developed Microsoft Excel macro suite to automate expense accruals and intercompany allocations, cutting manual processing time by 60%.

Skills
Financial Modelling, FP&A, Microsoft Excel, IFRS
SAP FICO, Power BI, Variance Analysis
Figma, UI/UX Design, Confluence
Linux, Git

Education
CA, ICAI

Notice period: 30 days
